decisions.reason: The line has several models and sits in the firm's core safety-shoe business, so its tooling and range investment favours persistence even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The comfort insole needs little investment and is only mentioned, which weakens commitment, but it complements the core footwear and costs little to keep after one year.
The supportive insole carries little visible commitment, but it fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, so early results can still be read as temporary.
The ergonomic series has its own page and several models, which signals substantial investment and public commitment in line with the firm's announced innovation direction.
Firefighter boots require costly certification and specialised development, so sunk costs and a long tender-based sales cycle argue for persisting.
As the home-page flagship of the firm's direction, the moulded insole carries the strongest public commitment and need for justification, making a drop very unlikely.
